description: A 25-year-old pregnant woman in her second trimester reports severe headache, blurred vision, and swelling in her hands and face. Her blood pressure is 150/100 mmHg.
A 6-month-old infant is brought with a cough and fast breathing (55 breaths per minute) for the last 3 days. No chest in-drawing is observed.
A 30-year-old woman presents with high fever, chills, and lower abdominal pain. She had a normal vaginal delivery 5 days ago. Foul-smelling vaginal discharge is present.
A 1-year-old child presents with loose stools for 4 days. The child is irritable, has sunken eyes, and skin pinch goes back slowly. He is drinking eagerly.
A 20-year-old primigravida at 38 weeks gestation complains of decreased fetal movements for the past 12 hours. Her vitals are normal.
